Remove all protective films, including the plastic wrapping from the filter inside the front panel.
Place the purifier along the room’s longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture.
Turn it on and leave it running 24/7 for best results.
Keep the air intake and outlet grills unobstructed. For homes with pets or heavy dust, periodically vacuum the screen pre-filter.
